verdict.rationale: Rootly is an incident-management SaaS, so outbound webhooks are a fair axis, but the evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Workflows (trigger events plus actions for Slack, Jira and similar tools), inbound alert ingestion, the REST API and the MCP server are adjacent features, not event subscriptions a programmatic consumer can receive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
